steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates described Kubota as Japan’s largest farm machinery maker and a global leader in compact tractors, popular with homesteaders and hobby farmers, and noted its strong presence in rice farming equipment across Asia.

episode.title: Agriculture: Robots, Drones and the Future of Food | The Decade Ahead

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates said Kubota dominated globally in smaller, compact tractors and was Japan’s largest farm machinery manufacturer, pointing to a strong competitive position in its core niches.

episode.title: Agriculture: Robots, Drones and the Future of Food | The Decade Ahead

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates said Kubota was pushing into autonomous and AI-driven technologies, including a driverless rice and wheat combine and a transformer-style multi-task farm robot, indicating active investment in innovation.
